description: The solar vitamin D synthesis window for ONE specific day at a location, for a personal profile: when UV is strong enough (index ≥ 3), the best hour, the clear-sky minutes needed to reach the target IU, and (with atTime) the minutes at the specific hour the user plans to go out. Returns synthesisPossible=false when the sun never gets high enough that day. Only for single-day questions — for months, seasons or 'when during the year', call get_vitamin_d_year instead of calling this once per date.

age.description: Age in years (synthesis declines with age); omit for adult baseline

atTime.description: Local HH:MM the user plans to go out — adds minutesNeeded and UV at that exact time

date.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today

elevationM.description: Ground elevation in metres (UV rises ~8%/km); default sea level

exposedSkinFraction.description: Skin exposed: 0.10 face+hands, 0.18 face+arms, 0.25 t-shirt+shorts (default), 0.40 swimsuit

skinType.description: Fitzpatrick skin type 1 (very fair) to 6 (very dark); default 3

targetIU.description: Vitamin D target per session in IU; default 1000

timezone.description: IANA timezone like 'Europe/Madrid'. Strongly recommended — without it all times are UTC

name: get_vitamin_d_window
